name: mcp-sync
description: A local configuration CLI that defines MCP servers once and reconciles them into supported MCP clients.
osps_ac_01_01_justification: Organization-required secure-method MFA and the non-disclosing verification record are documented at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/organization-access-and-recovery.md#authentication-and-collaborator-access-policy
osps_ac_02_01_justification: Organization base access is none and elevated grants are manual and repository-specific: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/organization-access-and-recovery.md#authentication-and-collaborator-access-policy
osps_ac_03_01_justification: The active Protect main ruleset requires pull requests and strict app-bound checks, with a rejected direct-update exercise recorded at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-governance.md#mcp-030-verification-record
osps_ac_03_02_justification: The active Protect main ruleset blocks primary-branch deletion, with a rejected deletion exercise recorded at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-governance.md#mcp-030-verification-record
osps_br_01_01_justification: Untrusted workflow metadata crosses typed environment boundaries and exact validation, while a static gate rejects direct expression interpolation: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-supply-chain.md#untrusted-code-and-metadata-boundary
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull-request workflows are read-only and secretless, use no protected environment or OIDC authority, and cannot feed a publisher: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-supply-chain.md#untrusted-code-and-metadata-boundary
osps_br_03_01_justification: Every maintained official project and distribution URI uses HTTPS: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/project-community-and-licensing.md#official-project-channels
osps_br_03_02_justification: The immutable release, signed provenance, exact hashes, byte-identical Cargo and Homebrew payloads, and pinned-host publisher form the authenticated distribution chain: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-supply-chain.md#authenticated-distribution-chain
osps_br_07_01_justification: Secret-file exclusions, provider-pattern secret scanning, push protection, and a non-disclosing zero-open-finding gate protect the repository: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-security.md#openssf-osps-mapping
osps_do_01_01_justification: Installation, configuration, every basic command, limitations, safe operation, and recovery are documented in https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync#readme and https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/m1-usage-and-recovery.md
osps_do_02_01_justification: Defect reporting and private vulnerability routing are documented at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#report-a-defect and https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/SUPPORT.md
osps_gv_02_01_justification: GitHub Issues and pull-request conversations are the public mechanisms for proposed changes and usage obstacles: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/project-community-and-licensing.md#public-contribution-and-support-boundary
osps_gv_03_01_justification: The contribution process, safety rules, setup, tests, terms, and protected pull-request path are documented at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_le_02_01_justification: The source uses the OSI-approved MIT License: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/LICENSE
osps_le_02_02_justification: The Cargo package, GNU/Linux software archives, and Homebrew formula carry the same MIT license: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/project-community-and-licensing.md#source-and-release-licensing
osps_le_03_01_justification: Both in-scope codebases maintain a root LICENSE: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/project-community-and-licensing.md#repository-and-codebase-inventory
osps_le_03_02_justification: The tagged source, published crate, and GNU/Linux software archives include the matching LICENSE alongside released software: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/project-community-and-licensing.md#source-and-release-licensing
osps_qa_01_01_justification: The authoritative source repository is publicly readable and unarchived at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync
osps_qa_01_02_justification: GitHub exposes the attributable and timestamped complete public commit history at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/commits/main/
osps_qa_02_01_justification: Cargo.toml lists every direct Rust dependency and Cargo.lock records the resolved graph: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/Cargo.toml
osps_qa_04_01_justification: The complete mcp-sync source and Homebrew distribution codebase inventory, roles, and exclusions are documented at https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/project-community-and-licensing.md#repository-and-codebase-inventory
osps_qa_05_01_justification: Generated executables and packages are forbidden in source history and rejected by the CI artifact gate: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-supply-chain.md#generated-executable-and-binary-artifact-policy
osps_qa_05_02_justification: Unreviewable binary blobs and submodules are rejected while reviewable text scripts remain allowed: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/docs/repository-supply-chain.md#generated-executable-and-binary-artifact-policy
osps_vm_02_01_justification: SECURITY.md names the maintainers as security contacts and provides a stable private reporting route plus a detail-free fallback: https://github.com/EnjoyableWork/mcp-sync/blob/main/SECURITY.md#security-contacts-and-private-reporting
